Geometry-derived analysis identifies Bi and Cu centers as octahedrally coordinated by six F neighbors, while K centers show a close-packed-like arrangement with 12 F neighbors. The Bi and Cu octahedra share corners, and K-centered 12-vertex polyhedra share faces with both Bi and Cu octahedra. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites.
